references.text: Parallel text in Leviticus giving the same dietary rules about water-dwelling creatures with fins and scales that are clean to eat
Ezekiel's prophecy about fish in the holy land, showing that fish continued to be an important food source in Israel's future vision
Jesus mentions fish as a good gift, which presupposes knowledge of clean fish species with fins and scales
Jesus feeds the crowd with bread and fish, where the fish would have been clean according to the Mosaic Law
Peter's vision about clean and unclean animals, showing how Old Testament dietary laws were understood in the early church
